_comment: SCENE 1 timing sheet. Retime any beat by editing 'at' (ms from cutscene start). Beat names map to handlers in src/game/cutscene.js — beats with unknown names are caption-only. 'caption' shows as story text ('caption_ms' = how long, default 4500). Total length = 'hardcut'.

beats.name: deal
beats.caption: The library, after hours.
beats._: fade in on the table + silhouette

beats.name: deal_envelope
beats.caption: An envelope of cash. The price of my family.
beats._: the envelope slides across the table

beats.name: deal_hands
beats.caption: I took it.
beats._: the player's hands take the envelope

beats.name: house
beats.caption: Their house. My house.
beats._: cut to the dark hallway; TV murmur + bad piano upstairs; slow walk forward

beats.name: act_approach
beats.caption: My uncle, at his piano. He never could play it right.
beats._: upstairs doorway — he is playing, back turned. slow push in

beats.name: act_black
beats._: CUT TO BLACK on the moment. never shown. audio only from here

beats.name: act_chair
beats._: a chair falls over. then silence

beats.name: aftermath
beats.caption: The house had never been so quiet.
beats._: fade back in. hold uncomfortably long

beats.name: turn
beats.caption: Someone was standing at the end of the hall.
beats._: the head turns on its own. a shape. it does not move

beats.name: hardcut
beats._: hard cut to the present-day library. control arrives seamlessly
